note: Adult reference intakes (RI) as used on EU and UK labels. Same caveat as fsa-thresholds.json: written from working knowledge, not transcribed from the regulation with a human checking. Flip to 'verified' only after someone reads Annex XIII of Regulation (EU) No 1169/2011 and confirms every value. Presented neutrally in the UI as percentages - never as 'you have used up X% of your day'.

sources.title: Regulation (EU) No 1169/2011 on the provision of food information to consumers, Annex XIII
